delivery_methodology: The project will be executed using an AI-enabled agile methodology characterized by short, time-boxed iterations with regular demonstrations and continuous client feedback. This iterative approach allows for incremental delivery of features, ensuring alignment with client expectations and timely adjustments to scope as needed.

AI tools will assist in drafting documentation, code generation, and testing, while human experts will review, integrate, and approve all outputs to maintain quality and accuracy. Quality assurance practices are embedded throughout the development cycle, including automated testing and code reviews. Change control processes will manage scope modifications to keep the project on track and aligned with business goals.
executive_summary: Kalinaw Trading Corporation seeks to enhance its human resource management through a comprehensive Human Resource Information System (HRIS) that streamlines employee data management, leave and attendance tracking, and reporting. This initiative is critical to improving operational efficiency, data accuracy, and decision-making capabilities within the HR function.

Exist Software Labs proposes a tailored HRIS solution that integrates key HR processes into a unified platform, delivered through a cloud-deployed microservices architecture. The system will be developed using proven technologies including Java, Spring Boot, React, and PostgreSQL, ensuring scalability and security. Upon completion, Kalinaw Trading Corporation will have a robust, user-friendly system that supports both HR staff and employees with self-service capabilities.
proposed_solution: The proposed HRIS solution consolidates essential HR functions such as employee information management, leave and attendance tracking, payroll interfacing, and reporting into a cohesive platform. HR staff will manage employee records, organizational structure, and leave policies, while employees will have self-service access to personal data, leave applications, attendance corrections, and payslips. The system supports multi-level approval workflows and automated notifications to streamline processes and ensure compliance.

This solution aligns with Kalinaw Trading Corporation’s operational needs by providing real-time dashboards and reports for management, automated leave balance computations, and integration with existing payroll systems. The approach emphasizes ease of use, data accuracy, and security, enabling the client to improve HR service delivery and employee engagement without disrupting current workflows.
technical_architecture: The HRIS is designed as a cloud-deployed microservices architecture leveraging Java and Spring Boot for backend services, React for the frontend interface, and PostgreSQL as the primary data store. This layered architecture separates concerns across presentation, business logic, and data persistence, facilitating scalability and maintainability.

Integration with external systems, such as the payroll system, is handled through secure APIs, ensuring seamless data exchange. The system supports role-based access control and audit trails to meet security and compliance requirements. Multiple environments will be used for development, testing, and production to ensure quality and reliability. This architecture supports the performance and availability targets specified by the client.
warranty_support: The solution includes a warranty period during which any defects or issues identified will be promptly addressed and corrected by Exist Software Labs. Defects can be reported through a defined support channel, and the warranty covers all functionality delivered as part of the agreed scope.

The warranty does not cover enhancements or changes outside the original scope, which can be addressed through separate support agreements. This approach ensures that Kalinaw Trading Corporation receives reliable support post-deployment while maintaining flexibility for future system evolution.
